How Stephen Curry connects

  • Faction: Golden State Warriors — Stephen Curry is the Golden State Warriors' shooting engine.
  • Concept: Three-point revolution — Stephen Curry's Warriors made the three-point revolution league-wide.
  • Event: NBA Finals — Stephen Curry's Warriors turned the Finals into a Bay Area series.

What is Stephen Curry?

Stephen Curry led the Golden State Warriors to multiple titles, two unanimous-adjacent MVP peaks, and a shooting revolution that rewrote spacing for the whole league.

Key threads lead to Golden State Warriors, Three-point revolution and NBA Finals.
